name: sl-corporate-income-tax
description: Sierra Leone company income-tax workpaper for the 2026 tax year, covering residence, ordinary taxable profit, allowable losses, financial costs, minimum alternate tax and the annual compliance record. Use for a resident company, an overseas company operating in Sierra Leone, company tax estimates, a loss claim or a distribution and withholding review. It separates the ordinary profit tax from the turnover-based minimum, traces the recent Finance Acts and preserves the old Guide topics through corrections or explicit holds. It identifies the unresolved minimum-tax schedule wording instead of supplying an unsupported universal percentage. Two examples recompute the ordinary tax component and a loss-utilisation decision. Current forms, complete later-law reconciliation, specialist regimes and final filing approval remain unfinished.
